limits: The observed outputs use simple absolute Voice sequences. This audit does not implement or test all LilyPond grammar.
Native prompts explicitly asked for sharp-only spellings. Valid flats break that request, even though full LilyPond supports them.
Component recovery is a counterfactual sensitivity result. It does not replace the frozen assessment.
This audit covers only one format and one asymmetry. Composite notation is not independently judged here.
No rejected case becomes a strict full musical success. Runtime engraving and context layout were not compiler tested.
method: Official LilyPond 2.24.4 manual establishes full-language note spellings, absolute octave semantics, rational duration scaling, parallel music, and named contexts. Each full payload was inspected. A separate transcriber used those rules for the simple grammar actually emitted; it did not call the repository LilyPond parser. It computed MIDI=48+natural_pitch_class+accidental+12*(apostrophes-commas), a fresh rational cursor per Voice, and quarter-duration*multiplier. The existing component scorer was then used only to tally the independently decoded notes under the original rubric. Independent full-contract checks and manual calculations verify the deep sample. All accepted cases preserve their component counts. No frozen score or observation was edited.
selection: Inventory all 30 repeat=1 native note-output cases. Deep manual review of all 3 rejected cases, 6 accepted error cases, and 3 correct controls. This is a targeted audit, not a random sample.
